stories.description: Build a refund endpoint for card payments with idempotency keys and full audit logging of refund events.
Nightly job that reconciles settled transactions against the ledger and raises mismatches for review.
Internal form for analysts to log chargebacks with reason codes and attachments.
Service that exports audit trail entries to CSV with column selection and date range filters.
Restrict export visibility by team role; analysts see their team, auditors see all.
One login path for the payments and audit services.
Cap retries so a bad client cannot stall the queue.
The note that goes out when a release is cut.

pull_requests.title: Add card refund endpoint with idempotency keys
pull_requests.body: Implements the refund endpoint for card payments. Includes idempotency-key handling, audit logging of every refund event, and tests covering duplicate submissions.
pull_requests.author: nora

pull_requests.title: Nightly settlement reconciliation job
pull_requests.body: Adds the nightly reconciliation of settled transactions against the ledger. Mismatches are written to a review table and surfaced to the operations dashboard.
pull_requests.author: june

pull_requests.title: Bump dependency versions
pull_requests.body: Routine dependency updates: patch releases for internal libraries, no behaviour change.
pull_requests.author: nora

pull_requests.title: CSV export service with date range filters
pull_requests.body: Export audit trail entries to CSV. Supports column selection and date range filtering per the export requirements.
pull_requests.author: theo

pull_requests.title: Fix flaky export test
pull_requests.body: Removes a race condition in the export test fixture by injecting a deterministic clock.
pull_requests.author: theo

items.title: Demo Vendor (MVP)
completed: The MVP launched successfully on Mar 16.
The launch moved from Mar 14 to Mar 16 to absorb late requests from the client team.
Weekly onboarding sessions are already running.

items.title: Sample Advisor
completed: Three of the eight team members are now working on Sample Advisor.
Access to both the production and UAT environments is in hand.
The UAT completion date has moved from Apr 1 to Apr 15, because a weekly cadence with the partner team has not been possible.
next: Hold Apr 15 as the internal target for UAT completion.
Ask for leadership: support in securing a weekly slot with the partner team.

items.title: Example Casework, Phase 1 MVP
completed: Two pieces of the original plan remain, the message queue and the metrics dashboard, and both are in active build.
next: Complete both, targeting Apr 30 and no later than May 15.

items.title: Example Corp Contract Renegotiation
completed: Pricing is agreed. The existing master agreement stays in place.
next: Meet Taylor next week to finalise the contract, expected to take about a month.

items.title: Additional December Leave for the Team
completed: For information: additional leave is planned for the team members who committed exceptionally this year.
The leave extends the standard December break, so capacity drops earlier than usual.
The aim is to keep morale going, and the owner hopes the Director will support it.

briefs.bottom_line: Two March launches remain on track, and the Example Corp renegotiation is expected to save approximately $50,000 a year. The principal risk is the loss of contractor capacity, which will push delivery dates until replacement staff are confirmed.

items.headline: Replacement staff needed to protect priority 2029 delivery
items.what: The portfolio has already been reduced, and the team has now been asked to release its contractor staffing. Detailed replacement requests have been sent to Jordan Example for allocation.
items.why: The team cannot give reliable delivery dates until replacements are onboarded, and major delays are expected across the top-priority 2029 projects.
items.action: Reinforce the urgency of the staffing allocation and support resetting stakeholder timelines until replacements are confirmed.

items.headline: Example Casework launches March 12
items.what: The screening team is ready to launch Example Casework on March 12. Final demos are under way and the launch email goes out shortly.
items.why: This is the screening team's largest delivery of the year and moves the new workflow into production.
items.action: Complete final demos and send launch communications before go-live.

items.headline: Demo Vendor version one launches March 22
items.what: The first version of Demo Vendor is on track for March 22, with no current blockers.
items.why: It is the first phase of a wider due-diligence expansion across suppliers, advisers and partners.
items.action: Complete readiness activities and launch on March 22.

items.headline: Example Corp renegotiation targets approximately $50,000 in annual savings
items.what: The team is renegotiating a Example Corp contract worth about $100,000, with expected annual savings of approximately $50,000.
items.why: The scope expands capability while reducing future reliance on contractors.
items.action: Complete commercial negotiations and confirm final scope and savings.
